summon.warning.title: WARNING
summon.warning.line1: Do not use this mod on your main installation.
summon.warning.line2: Do not run with resource packs or other mods.
summon.warning.wip: This mod is unfinished — expect bugs.
summon.world.corrupted: This world can no longer be entered.
summon.broken.author: Author: %s
msg.world: How do you like my world? Yeah, it's a bit messy, but still beautiful.
msg.guests: I'm always happy to have guests, but don't stay too long.
msg.time: I think it's time for you to go.
msg.entity_leaves: Fine... take your riches and leave.
msg.good_ending: The world is collapsing. Go now, while you still can.
book.first.title: Note I
book.first.page1: Damn, how did you get in here? I asked you not to come. Alright, we don't have much time. Look for useful resources, I'll be back soon.
book.second.title: Note II
book.second.page1: I can get you out of here. Try to find as many valuable ores as you can — they'll help you escape.
book.third.title: Note III
book.third.page1: Damn, that entity isn't happy about you.
book.fourth.title: Note IV
book.fourth.page1: You still have a little time! Maybe the entity will spare you if you give up your resources. But if you don't make it in time...
